included: Own factual observations, brief geographic labels, official publisher URLs and bounded selected identifier/name-state/count/bounds metadata. Any public-file validation hashes cover included public evidence only.
rights_scope: Official publication status is not treated as blanket permission to redistribute complete PDFs, map rasters, crops or overlays. No source body, coordinate-bearing geometry or private source/coordinate/derivative fingerprint is included. This component contains original factual extracts and public bibliography only.
reproducibility_limit: Public included-file checks can verify the retained factual record and its bounded metadata, but cannot replay the omitted source-map and complete-polygon visual comparison.
